assay_description: Binding affinity to human 5-HT2B receptor by radioligand displacement assay

Antagonist activity at human 5-HT2B receptor expressed in HEK293 cells coexpressing EBNA assessed as inhibition of 5-HT-induced IP metabolism incubated for 20 mins prior to substrate addition measured after 20 mins by liquid scintillation counting analysis
